title: SPICA: Retrieving Scenarios for Pluralistic In-Context Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the appropriateness of model outputs using human preference ratings from annotators divided by partisan political affiliation (Republican vs. Democrat) to measure pluralistic value alignment and disparities in default model behavior.

Evaluating the appropriateness of model outputs using human preference ratings from annotators divided by self-reported participation in religious activities (religious vs. non-religious) to measure differences in value alignment across religious identities.
